profile.headline: Web-Product Strategist | Front-End Dev | Storytelling for Finance & Hospitality
profile.summary:
I’m driven by the challenge of building digital experiences that are not only functional, but intuitive and meaningful. Over the past decade, I’ve worked at the intersection of development, design, and communication—helping transform complex ideas into user-first solutions across industries like finance, hospitality, and media.

My strength lies in bridging technical concepts with strategic goals. Whether I’m collaborating with designers on UX flow, analyzing behavior through analytics tools, or translating API capabilities into everyday language, I aim to create digital experiences that resonate with real people and solve real problems.

I thrive in environments where I can work cross-functionally, move quickly, and deliver value through thoughtful execution. I’m always exploring new tools and approaches to improve communication between technology and the people it serves.

Tools & Competencies: Front-End Development · UX Strategy · Digital Communication · Behavioral Analytics · API Integration · Cross-Team Collaboration · Technical Copywriting
